items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and make no new spend, production admission, or revenue forecast. AI usage cost was $995.61 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,502 calls, including 234 errors; Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites, and analytics is unavailable for all 38 expected sites, so contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, conversion rates, and causal lift are not calculable. Do not present clicks, orders, shipped items, AI calls, proposals, or impressions as financial outcomes. Monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, revenue-target, and revenue-floor fields are blank, so budget exposure and variance are also unknown. Retain only the existing slot-gated allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity and repair gates clear; require registered site attribution and period-aligned revenue/cost evidence before any ROI or margin claim.
